security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost https://raw.githubusercontent.com https://github.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Desktop remote access client (SSH, Serial, Telnet, FTP)
bundle.longDescription: Terminalku is a fast, lightweight desktop remote access client for network engineers and system administrators. It bundles SSH, Telnet, serial console, FTP/FTPS, and a local terminal into a single multi-tab workspace with split views, snippet macros, and passive vendor detection.
